content:
"For PRUSA veterans: Fasteners are divided into individual bags according to its type. Not into packages for individual chapters, as it was with previous printers."

Feedback on this: This is not a good change. The sheer scale of this upgrade makes it an especially bad place to make this change. Way too high a percentage of the time in this guide was spent going through the multiple sub-boxes and trying to find the right baggie yet again.
